name: The Monday content brief for the café
source: real menu and post history (Cardamom Corner Café)

fields.name: Cardamom Corner Café
fields.tone_notes: Gentle, cosy and neighbourly. Calm, unhurried sentences; warm but never gushing. Mention the bakes and the cardamom latte when it fits. Never pushy.
fields.halal_statement: Our chicken is halal. We don't serve pork or alcohol.
fields.allergen_statement: Our bakes contain nuts, gluten, eggs and dairy. Please ask before you order.

recent_posts.text: There's a quiet kind of comfort in a Cardamom Latte (£3.85) and a slice of Pistachio Rose Cake (£4.50), and we think they were made for each other. Our signature latte is warm with spice, and the cake is fresh and fragrant. Settle in by the window and take your time. Pop in this week, we're open from 07:30 on weekdays. ☕

content.text: Here is this week's content brief. Three quick shoots, each doable in about 5 minutes on a phone during service. Please forward to the team.

shoots.what: Photo of an Almond Croissant, plated on its own.
shoots.where: At the counter or a table with good daylight. Keep the background tidy.
shoots.how: Phone held just above the plate at a slight angle. Use daylight, not flash. Take 3 or 4 shots and send the best one. No hands or faces in the frame.
shoots.caption: Almond Croissant, £3.25. A small, quiet treat for the middle of the morning. Our bakes contain nuts, gluten, eggs and dairy, so please ask us before you order.

shoots.what: Short video of Karak Chai being poured into a cup.
shoots.where: At the drinks station, close to the cup.
shoots.how: Phone vertical, about 10 seconds, steady hands. Start on the cup and follow the pour. Film at a quiet moment before the evening rush. No customers in the shot.
shoots.caption: Karak Chai, £2.95. Poured slowly, the way it should be. Come in and take your time.

shoots.what: Photo of a Masala Omelette on the plate, ready to serve.
shoots.where: At a table near the window, or the brightest spot in the café.
shoots.how: Phone held directly above the plate. Daylight only. Wipe the plate rim first. Take 3 or 4 shots and send the best one. Keep customers out of the frame.
shoots.caption: Masala Omelette, £7.50. A warm, unhurried start to your Saturday. We open at 8:30am.
